```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)

# Define graphical style from rq1_1201
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}

theme_set(theme_nature())

# Palette consistent with previous files
mode_colors <- c("Strict Bilateral" = "#4A90E2", 
                 "Multilateral" = "#E85D75", 
                 "Hyperauthored" = "#E8B861",
                 "Other" = "gray")

data_reg <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    n_authors = as.numeric(n_authors),
    n_countries = as.numeric(n_countries),
    is_hyperauthored = n_authors >= 100,
    collaboration_mode = case_when(
      is_hyperauthored ~ "Hyperauthored",
      n_countries == 2 ~ "Strict Bilateral",
      n_countries > 2 ~ "Multilateral",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    collaboration_mode = factor(collaboration_mode, 
                                levels = c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored", "Other"))
  )
```


```{r}
# Table 1: Structural Characteristics
data_reg |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `Mean Authors` = mean(n_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Mean Citations` = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Median Citations` = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(Share = sprintf("%.1f%%", N / sum(N) * 100)) |>
  bind_rows(
    data_reg |>
      summarise(
        collaboration_mode = "Total",
        N = n(),
        `Mean Authors` = mean(n_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Mean Citations` = mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Median Citations` = median(cited, na.rm = TRUE),
        Share = "100.0%"
      )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, N, Share, everything()) |>
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "Table 1: Structural Characteristics by Collaboration Mode") 
```


```{r}
# Figure 1: Stacked Area Chart of Growth
data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode != "Other") |>
  count(year, collaboration_mode) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = n, fill = collaboration_mode)) +
  geom_area(alpha = 0.8, color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = mode_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2000, 2024, 4)) +
  labs(
    title = "Evolution of Collaboration Modes (2000-2024)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Publications",
    fill = NULL
  )
```


```{r}
# Table 2: Disciplinary Composition (Top Subjects per Mode)
subject_cols <- c("agr_bio", "art_hum", "bio_chem", "buss", "chem_eng", 
                  "chem", "comp_sci", "earth", "econ", "ener", "egin", 
                  "env_sci", "immu", "mat_sci", "math", "med", "neuro", 
                  "nurse", "pharm", "phys", "psy", "soc_sci", "vet")

# Calculate totals per mode for percentage normalization
mode_totals <- data_reg |> 
  filter(collaboration_mode != "Other") |>
  count(collaboration_mode, name = "total_docs")

# Calculate subject counts
subject_counts <- data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode != "Other") |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, all_of(subject_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -collaboration_mode, names_to = "Subject", values_to = "Present") |>
  filter(Present == 1) |>
  count(collaboration_mode, Subject)

# Identify Top 5 subjects for each mode
top_subjects <- subject_counts |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 5) |>
  pull(Subject) |>
  unique()

# Create wide table
subject_counts |>
  filter(Subject %in% top_subjects) |>
  left_join(mode_totals, by = "collaboration_mode") |>
  mutate(Pct = sprintf("%.1f%%", n / total_docs * 100)) |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, Subject, Pct) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = collaboration_mode, values_from = Pct, values_fill = "0.0%") |>
  arrange(desc(`Strict Bilateral`)) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 2: Disciplinary Composition (Prevalence of Top Subjects per Mode)") 
```

```{r}
# Graphical theme consistent with Part 1
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}
theme_set(theme_nature())

# Palette for Strict vs Multilateral
equity_colors <- c("Strict Bilateral" = "#4A90E2", 
                   "Multilateral" = "#E74C3C")

data_reg <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    collaboration_mode = factor(collaboration_mode, 
                                levels = c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored", "Other"))
  )

# Core Corpus: Excluding Hyperauthored for Equity Analysis
data_core <- data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode %in% c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral")) |>
  droplevels()
```


```{r}
# Figure 2: Violin Plot of Vietnamese Author Proportions
# Objective: Visualize distribution differences. Hypothesis: Bilateral is closer to 0.5 (Parity).
ggplot(data_core, aes(x = collaboration_mode, y = prop_vn_authors, fill = collaboration_mode)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.6, color = NA) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = equity_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 2: Distribution of Vietnamese Authorship Proportions",
    y = "Proportion of Vietnamese Authors",
    x = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{r}
# Table 3: Leadership Distribution (Total N = 9,708)
# Objective: Contrast leadership opportunities in pure vs. networked partnerships
data_core |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    VN_Led = sum(vn_led),
    JP_Led = sum(jp_led),
    Other_Led = sum(fa_o)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `% VN-Led` = sprintf("%.1f%%", VN_Led / n * 100),
    `% JP-Led` = sprintf("%.1f%%", JP_Led / n * 100),
    `% Other-Led` = sprintf("%.1f%%", Other_Led / n * 100)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, n, VN_Led, `% VN-Led`, JP_Led, `% JP-Led`, Other_Led, `% Other-Led`) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 3: Leadership Distribution by Collaboration Mode") 
```


```{r}
# Statistical Validation of Differences
t_test <- t.test(prop_vn_authors ~ collaboration_mode, data = data_core)
chisq_led <- chisq.test(table(data_core$collaboration_mode, data_core$vn_led))

tibble(
  Indicator = c("Mean VN Authorship Share", "VN Leadership Rate"),
  `Strict Bilateral` = c(
    sprintf("%.3f", mean(data_core$prop_vn_authors[data_core$collaboration_mode == "Strict Bilateral"], na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(data_core$vn_led[data_core$collaboration_mode == "Strict Bilateral"]) * 100)
  ),
  `Multilateral` = c(
    sprintf("%.3f", mean(data_core$prop_vn_authors[data_core$collaboration_mode == "Multilateral"], na.rm = TRUE)),
    sprintf("%.1f%%", mean(data_core$vn_led[data_core$collaboration_mode == "Multilateral"]) * 100)
  ),
  Test = c("Welch Two Sample t-test", "Pearson's Chi-squared"),
  Statistic = c(sprintf("t = %.2f", t_test$statistic), sprintf("X2 = %.2f", chisq_led$statistic)),
  `p-value` = c(sprintf("%.3e", t_test$p.value), sprintf("%.3e", chisq_led$p.value))
) |>
  kable(caption = "Statistical Comparison of Equity Indicators (Bilateral vs. Multilateral)") 
```



# 4

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(MASS)
library(modelsummary)
library(ggeffects)
library(scales)

theme_nature <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
    )
}
theme_set(theme_nature())

data_reg <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    collaboration_mode = factor(collaboration_mode, 
                                levels = c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored", "Other")),
    quartile = as.character(quartile),
    quartile = if_else(is.na(quartile) | quartile == "Unknown" | quartile == "", "Non-Q1", quartile),
    quartile = factor(quartile, levels = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Non-Q1")),
    fund = factor(fund, labels = c("Unfunded", "Funded"))
  )

data_core <- data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode %in% c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral")) |>
  mutate(
    year_centered = year - 2000,
    prop_vn_centered = prop_vn_authors - mean(prop_vn_authors, na.rm = TRUE),
    is_Q1 = if_else(quartile == "Q1", 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
# Table 4: Descriptive Impact Matrix
# Objective: Compare Mean (Median) citations across Leadership and Mode
impact_summary <- data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode != "Other") |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode, vn_led) |>
  summarise(
    Metric = sprintf("%.1f (%d)", mean(cited, na.rm = TRUE), median(cited, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Leadership = if_else(vn_led == 1, "VN-Led", "JP/Other-Led")) |>
  dplyr::select(-vn_led) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Leadership, values_from = Metric)

data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode != "Other") |>
  count(collaboration_mode) |>
  left_join(impact_summary, by = "collaboration_mode") |>
  dplyr::select(collaboration_mode, n, `VN-Led`, `JP/Other-Led`) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 4: Descriptive Impact Matrix (Mean and Median Citations)") 
```


```{r}
# Table 5: Negative Binomial Regression Results (Core Corpus Only)
m1 <- glm.nb(cited ~ vn_led + jp_led + year_centered + LS + PS + HS + SS, 
             data = data_core)

m2 <- update(m1, . ~ . + collaboration_mode + prop_vn_centered)

m3 <- update(m2, . ~ . + fund + is_Q1)

m4 <- update(m3, . ~ . + vn_led:fund)

modelsummary(
  list(
    "M1: Baseline" = m1, 
    "M2: Structure" = m2, 
    "M3: Resources" = m3, 
    "M4: Interactions" = m4
  ),
  stars = TRUE,
  exponentiate = TRUE, 
  gof_map = c("nobs", "aic", "bic"),
  coef_map = c(
    "vn_led" = "VN-led",
    "jp_led" = "JP-led",
    "collaboration_modeMultilateral" = "Multilateral Mode",
    "fundFunded" = "Funded",
    "is_Q1" = "Q1 Journal",
    "vn_led:fundFunded" = "VN-led × Funded"
  ),
  title = "Table 5: Negative Binomial Regression Results (Incidence Rate Ratios)"
)
```


```{r}
# Figure 3: Predicted Citations (Interaction Plot)
# Objective: Visualize VN-led papers catching up when funded
pred_fund <- ggpredict(m4, terms = c("fund", "vn_led")) |>
  mutate(group = if_else(group == "1", "VN-led", "JP/Other-led"))

ggplot(pred_fund, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, group = group)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(0.2), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("JP/Other-led" = "grey60", "VN-led" = "#2E86C1")) +
  labs(
    title = "Figure 3: Predicted Citations by Funding Status and Leadership",
    y = "Predicted Citations",
    x = NULL,
    color = NULL
  )
```

# 5


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)

data_reg <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    n_authors = as.numeric(n_authors),
    collaboration_mode = factor(collaboration_mode, 
                                levels = c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored", "Other")),
    fund = factor(fund, labels = c("Unfunded", "Funded"))
  )
```


```{r}
# Table 6: Funding Landscape by Mode (Mutually Exclusive Categories)
# Objective: Show who funds the partnership. Row Total = 100%.

funding_data <- data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode != "Other") |>
  mutate(
    Funding_Source = case_when(
      fund == "Unfunded" ~ "Unfunded",
      bilateral_funding == 1 ~ "Bilateral Co-funded",
      jap == 1 & vn == 0 ~ "Japan Unilateral",
      vn == 1 & jap == 0 ~ "Vietnam Unilateral",
      TRUE ~ "External/Other" # Funded but neither JP nor VN explicitly flagged (rare in Bilateral)
    ),
    Funding_Source = factor(Funding_Source, 
                            levels = c("Unfunded", "Japan Unilateral", "Vietnam Unilateral", 
                                       "Bilateral Co-funded", "External/Other"))
  )

funding_data |>
  count(collaboration_mode, Funding_Source) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  dplyr::select(-n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Funding_Source, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ percent(., accuracy = 0.1))) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 6: Funding Landscape by Collaboration Mode (Row Total = 100%)") 
```


```{r}
# Supplementary Check: External Funding Penetration
# Objective: Since "Japan Unilateral" might hide US/EU co-funding in Multilateral papers, 
# this table explicitly checks for US/EU presence regardless of JP/VN funding.

data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode != "Other") |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `US Funded` = percent(mean(us == 1), 0.1),
    `EU Funded` = percent(mean(eu == 1), 0.1),
    `International Funded` = percent(mean(int == 1), 0.1)
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Supplementary Table: Penetration of External Funding Sources") 
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)

# Theme
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 10) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
theme_set(theme_nature())

# Load Data
data_reg <- read.csv("data/processed_data.csv") |>
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(year),
    collaboration_mode = factor(collaboration_mode, 
                                levels = c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral", "Hyperauthored", "Other")),
    fund = factor(fund, labels = c("Unfunded", "Funded"))
  )

# Core Corpus
data_core <- data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode %in% c("Strict Bilateral", "Multilateral"))
```


```{r}
# Table 6: The Funding Landscape (Row Total = 100%)
# Objective: Show the heavy reliance on Japanese funding in bilateral work.

funding_data <- data_core |>
  mutate(
    Funding_Source = case_when(
      fund == "Unfunded" ~ "Unfunded",
      bilateral_funding == 1 ~ "Bilateral Co-funded",
      jap == 1 & vn == 0 ~ "Japan Unilateral",
      vn == 1 & jap == 0 ~ "Vietnam Unilateral",
      TRUE ~ "External/Other" # Funded by US/EU/Intl but not JP/VN
    ),
    Funding_Source = factor(Funding_Source, 
                            levels = c("Unfunded", "Japan Unilateral", "Vietnam Unilateral", 
                                       "Bilateral Co-funded", "External/Other"))
  )

funding_data |>
  count(collaboration_mode, Funding_Source) |>
  group_by(collaboration_mode) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  dplyr::select(-n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Funding_Source, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ percent(., accuracy = 0.1))) |>
  kable(caption = "Table 6: Funding Landscape by Collaboration Mode (Row Total = 100%)") 
```

# 5 add


```{r}
# Table S1: Top Disciplines in Hyper-authored Papers
# Objective: Justify exclusion by showing they are distinct from Core topics (e.g., Physics).

subject_cols <- c("agr_bio", "med", "eng", "env_sci", "phys", "chem", "mat_sci")

data_reg |>
  filter(collaboration_mode == "Hyperauthored") |>
  dplyr::select(any_of(subject_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Subject", values_to = "Present") |>
  filter(Present == 1) |>
  count(Subject, sort = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    `% of Hyper Set` = percent(n / 274, 0.1) # 274 is total hyper papers
  ) |>
  head(5) |>
  kable(caption = "Table S1: Top 5 Disciplines in Hyper-authored Papers (>100 Authors)") 
```


```{r}
# Table S2: Summary Statistics of Variables in Regression (N=9,708)
data_core |>
  dplyr::select(cited, n_authors, prop_vn_authors, year) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") |>
  group_by(Variable) |>
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD = sd(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min = min(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Max = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "Table S2: Summary Statistics for Continuous Regression Variables") 
```
